name: Lisa decide(needs_clarification) → coordinator ask_user
description:
ADR-044 §addendum Slice 6 (go-reviewer R2) — routes a planner escalation to the user. Lisa (dev-via-test-plan) may emit decide(needs_clarification) from her FIRST plan (rule 01 allowlist) OR from a re-plan (rule 02d allowlist) when the user's ask can't be turned into a faithful plan without clarification. Before Slice 6 no rule caught role=dev-via-test-plan + next_action=needs_clarification, so it silently dead-ended the chain. Slice 6 actively prompts it (02d's re-plan prompt + Lisa's emit-contract tell her to use it on an impossible finding), so the route is now load-bearing.

Mirrors the research/autoresearch needs-clarification-replan pattern, scoped to the planner role. Spawns a coordinator wake-up scoped to ask_user; the user clarifies and a fresh chain fires on their reply.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.coordinator
on_enter.prompt:
The dev-via-test planner (Lisa) at loop $entity.instance could not turn the user's request into a faithful plan and emitted needs_clarification.

Iteration 1 — call read_loop_result(loop_id=$entity.instance) to read Lisa's reason — what's blocking (ambiguous ask, contradictory requirements, missing detail).

Iteration 2 — call decide(action="ask_user", reason="<surface Lisa's blocker to the user as a plain-English question; ask for the specific clarification she needs>"). One question, addressed to the user, no internal jargon. The user replies and a fresh coordinator loop fires on their answer.

metadata.phase: ADR-044 §addendum Slice 6 — planner needs_clarification route (go-reviewer R2)
metadata.review_origin: go-reviewer R2 (2026-06-05): Lisa's needs_clarification (rule 01 + 02d allowlists) had no routing rule → silent chain dead-end. Slice 6 promotes it from unlikely to prompted, so this route is required.
metadata.catches_both: Conditions on role=dev-via-test-plan + needs_clarification, so it catches BOTH first-plan (rule 01) and re-plan (rule 02d) escalations.
